title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to the graphic published for Transmittal No. 20-31 in the August 26, 2020 arms sales notice (document 2020-18786); the corrected graphic itself is not included in the text.
summary: This Federal Register notice corrects an earlier arms sales notice (document 2020-18786, published August 26, 2020) for Transmittal No. 20-31, because the wrong graphic was printed in error. The text provides no country, dollar values, equipment, or contractor details; those would be in the corrected graphic, which is not reproduced in the text provided.

Arms Sales Notification

Correction

    In notice document 2020-18786, beginning on page 52567, in the 
issue of Wednesday, August 26, 2020 the incorrect graphic was 
inadvertently published in error. The correct graphic for Transmittal 
No. 20-31 is corrected to appear as set forth below.
